readme:
# Angular Language Service

The Angular team's language service for templates, both in `.html` files and inline in the `template:` of a component: diagnostics of the Angular compiler, completion, hover and navigation between a template and its component. The language server and TypeScript are bundled; the project needs its own `@angular/core` in `node_modules`, as in VS Code.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

Set `strictTemplates` in `angularCompilerOptions` of `tsconfig.json` for the most complete diagnostics.

## What works in Diode

Diagnostics of the Angular compiler in templates (`ngtsc`), completion of the component's members, of other components and of event and property bindings, hover and Go to Definition from a template into the component, references from a `.ts` file into templates, the Go to component lens in an `.html` template, and the commands Go to Template, Go to Component and View Template Typecheck Block. Highlighting of templates comes from the grammars of the extension.

## What does not

Completion has no plain HTML tags (`div`, `span`): in VS Code they come from the built-in HTML language features, which Diode does not have yet. Find All References from a `.ts` file lists the places in `.ts` files twice: both the built-in TypeScript and Angular answer. A rename started in a `.ts` file does not reach templates; this is the same in VS Code.
